title: Platform Engineer
description:
##### **Om kunden**


Vår kund är ett ledande teknikföretag inom försvars- och säkerhetsområdet och befinner sig mitt i en omfattande digital transformation. Inom verksamheten utvecklas gemensamma plattformar och arbetssätt som gör det möjligt för utvecklingsteam att arbeta snabbare, säkrare och mer effektivt med mjukvara, data och AI.


Du blir en del av ett växande plattformsteam med nära samarbete mellan plattformsingenjörer, Product Owner, arkitekter, utvecklare och säkerhetsspecialister. Kulturen präglas av kunskapsdelning, eget ansvar och möjligheten att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt.

##### **Om tjänsten**


Som Platform Engineer är du med och bygger och vidareutvecklar kundens moderna Application Runtime Platform. Plattformen är baserad på Kubernetes och körs idag i AWS med Amazon EKS. På sikt är ambitionen att plattformstjänsterna även ska kunna användas i Azure och on-premise-miljöer.


Plattformen befinner sig i ett tidigt utvecklingsskede, vilket innebär att tyngdpunkten ligger på nyutveckling, automatisering och att bygga nya förmågor. Du arbetar nära både mjukvaruutveckling och infrastruktur, där stora delar av miljön definieras och hanteras som kod.


I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* Utveckla en modern plattform och skapa funktioner som möter verksamhetens och utvecklingsteamens behov
* Automatisera arbetssätt och hantering av infrastruktur med hjälp av Infrastructure as Code
* Arbeta för att plattformen ska vara stabil, skalbar, säker och enkel att följa upp
* Ta fram verktyg, integrationer och självservicelösningar som förenklar utvecklarnas vardag
* Vara med och påverka framtida teknikval och hur plattformen ska utvecklas över tid
* Hjälpa utvecklingsteamen att komma igång med och dra nytta av plattformens funktioner
* Samarbeta nära arkitekter, säkerhetsspecialister och andra teknikteam inom cloud och on-premise


Du får stor möjlighet att påverka plattformens framtida riktning. Rollen passar dig som trivs i en miljö där tekniken, prioriteringarna och arbetssätten utvecklas löpande.

**Din kompetens**


Vi söker dig som har praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och containerplattformar. Du har arbetat med att designa, bygga, drifta eller vidareutveckla plattformstjänster och har förståelse för hur moderna, skalbara plattformar skapas.


Vi ser att du har:

* Praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och containerplattformar
* Erfarenhet av plattformstjänster eller andra verksamhetskritiska tekniska tjänster
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code och automatisering, exempelvis Terraform
* God förståelse för CI/CD och moderna leveransprocesser
* Kunskap om cloud native-teknik och principer inom plattformsutveckling
* Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

* Internal Developer Platforms, självservice och developer experience
* Hybrida Kubernetes-miljöer inom cloud och on-premise
* Observability, monitoring och plattformssäkerhet
* AWS, Amazon EKS eller Azure
* Större och komplexa organisationer där plattformar används av flera team
* Det är meriterande att ha goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift


Som person är du nyfiken, initiativtagande och bekväm med att ta ansvar utan detaljerad styrning. Du tycker om att samarbeta, dela kunskap och lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Eftersom plattformen fortfarande utvecklas behöver du också trivas med förändring och vilja vara med och forma lösningar som ännu inte är färdigdefinierade.

**Tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad och innebär att du behöver bli godkänd i en säkerhetsprövning. I samband med detta kan krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma.**

##### **Övrigt**


Lön: Fast månadslön


Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare


Start: Omgående med hänsyn tagen till din eventuella uppsägningstid


Placeringsort: Stockholm. Resor till Linköping förekommer några gånger per år


Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut, skicka din ansökan redan idag!

##### **Om oss**


Procruitment är Sveriges enda karriärbyrå inom IT, tech och engineering som genom proaktiv rekrytering förenar attraktiva arbetsgivare med människor som delar samma mål och ambitioner. Oavsett om du är en erfaren ledare eller om du ska ta ditt första steg ut i karriären hjälper vi dig att nå dina karriärmål - samtidigt som vi bryr oss om dig, din resa och att du mår bra längs vägen.  

  

Procruitment är stolta vinnare av Recruitment Awards och är utsedda till ***Årets Rekryteringsföretag*** och ***Årets Raket***samt ***Gasellföretag 2024*** *av* Dagens Industri*.*

Are you a driven sales professional with a passion for cybersecurity and new business? We are looking for a Enterprise Account Manager to drive growth within our Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) offering.  

This is an individual contributor role with full responsibility for driving new business in your market. Furthermore this position focused on expanding our IGA business within an established go-to-market setup, including defined offerings, a strong partner ecosystem, and internal solution expertise. Your primary focus will be to generate new business, build pipeline, and close deals in collaboration with partners and internal teams.  

You will be working with a cloud and on-prem IGA offering, targeting midsized and large enterprises across both private and public sectors. The solution is well-established, with existing customers, references, and a partner ecosystem. This position is based in Stockholm, Sweden.

In this role, you will focus on driving new logo acquisition within the IGA space. You will proactively engage the market, identify opportunities, and build a strong pipeline through direct outreach and close collaboration with strategic partners. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role where success is driven by your ability to create opportunities, progress deals, and win new business. This position plays a critical part in driving revenue growth and strengthening the organization, especially in the area of IGA.

#### **What you'll do**


A proactive “hunter” with a strong drive to create and win new business, experienced in building pipeline from scratch through outbound activities. Comfortable navigating complex enterprise environments and long sales cycles, and skilled at engaging multiple stakeholders across both business and IT. Results-driven, self-motivated, and highly focused on execution.  

  

**The role includes the following key responsibilities**

  

* Pipeline is built through a combination of events and webinars, partner-generated opportunities, inbound leads, and maturing existing pipeline.
* The role requires actively creating and driving pipeline, not only managing incoming opportunities.
* There is an existing pipeline of prospects and opportunities, but a continuous flow of new pipeline must be created and maintained in this role.
* Accountable for driving new business development and achieving defined business results
* Build and execute pipeline through proactive outbound activities and direct market engagement
* Develop opportunities in close collaboration with strategic partners
* Own and actively manage partner collaboration to drive joint business
* Drive new business within the IGA domain, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition
* Maintain strong activity levels across the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing


Success in the role is measured by building and converting a qualified pipeline and closing new customers within the IGA space.#### **What we're looking for**


You have a proven track record of new business generation and pipeline creation. Experience within cybersecurity, preferably within IAM and IGA, and you have a strong ability to work with partners to drive sales opportunities. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  

* Minimum five years of experience in sales within cybersecurity or related enterprise software
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Language requirements are English and Swedish

#### **About us**

**Who We Are**  

Pointsharp is a European cybersecurity company founded in 2006. Pointsharp provides specialized software and services that help organizations secure identities, authorization, access, and data in a user-friendly way. We believe that easy-to-use security solutions are the foundation of a secure, modern digital workplace.  

  

Pointsharp – Security Made Easy  

  

**Our Workplace and Culture**  

We offer a varied and exciting work environment at an international company that is just beginning its growth journey. At Pointsharp, our employees are at the center of everything we do. We go to great length to foster our community and culture—a culture that has long been shaped by entrepreneurship and a strong focus on technology. This contributes to short decision-making paths and great opportunities for growth within your role and the company. At Pointsharp, all genders are welcome.

Join us at Zendesk, where we're on a mission to power exceptional service for every person on the planet. * Knowledge of the Swedish and Danish industrial ecosystem and relevant customer or distributor networks is an advantage.
* Fluent English and professional proficiency in Swedish and/or Danish; proficiency in both languages is a strong advantage.
* Self-motivated, well organized and accountable, with a proactive and collaborative working style.
* Willingness to travel approximately 30-50% across the assigned territory and occasionally to other European locations; a valid driving license is required.

**What are your perks?**
* International technology company with high autonomy and visible impact.

title: Principal Server Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of games played by millions? As a Principal Server Engineer at Snowprint, you are part of a game team, designing, developing and operating the game. You'll combine hands-on development with long-term technical vision. Everything you do impacts the player experience and how we build games.
  
  

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and taking ownership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take responsibility, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together. What you’ll be doing Together with the team, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction of our backend systems, designing and implementing solutions that support both current game features and future needs. You'll take the lead on complex technical features.
  
  

You'll work on both player-facing features and the systems, tooling and infrastructure behind them. This includes evolving our existing architecture, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring our backend solutions remain scalable, maintainable, efficient and secure as our games grow. You'll also play an important role in the technical development of the team. Working closely with other developers, you'll share knowledge, challenge ideas, provide technical guidance and help establish good practices.
  
  

You'll collaborate with designers and other disciplines to ensure that technical decisions support both development needs and the player experience. Is this you? You're a highly experienced server/backend engineer with a strong background in designing, building, and operating complex backend systems. You're fluent in Kotlin and/or Java.
  
  

You have experience shaping backend architecture and making technical decisions that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability. You're comfortable taking ownership of cloud infrastructure and have hands-on experience operating cloud environments. You have extensive experience with live services and understand the demands of keeping a game running. You're comfortable troubleshooting production issues, adapting to changing priorities, and finding solutions when things don't go as planned.
  
  

You're a strong technical voice who enjoys sharing knowledge, challenging ideas, and helping others grow. You communicate clearly, collaborate well and can explain complex technical decisions to people from different disciplines. Where you’ll work Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best.
  
  

We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio. About Snowprint Studios Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook. At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.
  
  

Join us in shaping the future of gaming! Pocket Gamer Awards Winner ‘Mobile game of the year’ and ‘Best strategy game’ 2022 Pocket Gamer Awards Winner 'Best game we are still playing’ 2024 & 2026 Pocket Gamer Awards Finalist, ‘Best developer’ 2025 Pocket Gamer Awards Winner, ‘Best updated game’ & ‘Best community’ 2026 Good to know We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

title: Trading Systems Specialist: Electronic Trading | SEB, Solna
description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

  

**About the role**



You will work across the lifecycle of our electronic trading systems, from requirements and solution design to implementation, testing, and support. You will collaborate closely with traders, vendors, infrastructure teams, and other technology units to resolve issues and deliver stable solutions in a fast-moving environment. You will work at the intersection of technology and financial markets, where reliable systems are essential to the business.
  

  

This is a broad technical role combining production support, system integration, development, and close collaboration with the business.



Your responsibilities will include:


* Supporting and monitoring business-critical electronic trading systems
* Troubleshooting technical and functional issues and driving incidents through to resolution
* Maintaining, configuring, and integrating trading applications, including ULlink
* Improving platform stability through root-cause analysis, automation, and stronger monitoring
* Working with order routing, exchange connectivity, and integrations across the electronic trading flow
* Contributing to requirements analysis, solution design, implementation, and testing
* Using scripting, programming, and AI-assisted tools to improve systems and ways of working
* Applying your knowledge of electronic trading and market structure to evolve the platform


**Who we are looking for**



You are an experienced technology professional who enjoys solving complex problems in business-critical environments. You combine technical depth with business understanding, take ownership, and communicate clearly with both technical specialists and business users.


**To thrive in this role, we believe that you have:**


* Several years of experience in application support, system integration, and trading technology
* A degree in computer science, systems science, finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* Knowledge of Linux and experience working with configurations, logs, and integrations
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to problem-solving
* A service-minded approach and excellent communication skills in Swedish and English
* A team player mindset, understanding that collaboration and communication is the key to success.
* Experience with one or more of the following would be valuable:
	+ ULlink, TBrick or similar products
	+ Equities or other traded asset classes
	+ Exchange and market connectivity, FIX protocol
	+ Scripting or programming for automation and technical support

You do not need to be a full-time software developer. What matters is your ability to understand technical solutions, investigate problems systematically, and use code or scripts when appropriate.


**What we offer**


* You will join a collaborative and knowledgeable team working with systems central to the electronic trading business.
* Close cooperation with traders and other business stakeholders
* A broad technical role with visible business impact
* Complex challenges involving trading flows, connectivity, integration, and production stability
* Opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence technical solutions and ways of working
* The chance to explore how AI and emerging technologies can improve our platforms


If you are motivated by solving complex technical problems, taking ownership of business-critical systems, and working closely with the financial markets, we would be happy to hear from you.

  

**Ready to join?**

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.


We encourage you to submit your application no later than 30th of November. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Team manager Thomas Erlandsson at Thomas.erlandsson@seb.se Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

  




SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.


The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer – AML
description:
*We’re looking for two experienced Fullstack Engineers to join our AML team in Solna. You’ll work with modern cloud-based technology, take ownership of technical decisions and help develop one of our most strategically important products.*

##### **About us**


At Verified, we build cloud-based solutions for identity verification, electronic signing and Anti-Money Laundering (AML). Our platform supports AML/KYC, supplier due diligence and secure digital workflows.


We’re around 100 people, mainly serving the Nordic market, with a user network that spans Europe. Our API-first platform lets businesses integrate secure, scalable services into their existing systems and workflows.


Technology is at the heart of what we do, and we keep investing in cloud infrastructure, scalable architecture and AI-driven solutions. Our engineers work in autonomous, cross-functional teams with shared ownership, a strong engineering culture and a real say in how our products and technology evolve.

##### **The role and the team**


As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you’ll help develop and scale our cloud-based AML platform. You’ll work across frontend, backend and cloud infrastructure, with significant influence over architecture and technical decisions.


You’ll join an experienced team of three senior Fullstack Engineers and work closely with our Product Owner, Designer, QA and Engineering Manager. The team has a high degree of autonomy and owns the full development lifecycle, from system design and implementation to deployment and operations.


Our stack is mainly Node.js and TypeScript on the backend, Vue.js on the frontend, and AWS and MongoDB Atlas for cloud infrastructure and data storage. The platform is API-first, with a strong focus on scalability, security and performance.


In the role, you will:

* Design and develop scalable cloud-based systems, REST APIs and modern web applications.
* Contribute to architecture and technical decisions, improving scalability and reducing system dependencies.
* Build integrations, manage complex data flows and improve system reliability.
* Drive engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD and troubleshooting.
* Use AI agents and automated workflows to improve our products and development processes.


AI is an important investment area for us. We’re continuously looking for ways to improve how we use AI and to stay up to date with new tools and practices, so you’ll have the chance to shape how AI is used across the development lifecycle and built into our products.


We see software engineering as a craft, where technical quality, thoughtful decisions and pragmatic solutions go hand in hand.

##### **What will you bring to the team?**


You’re an experienced Fullstack Engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges, taking ownership and contributing to technical decisions. You’re comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with other engineers and product stakeholders.


We think you have:

* At least five years of experience in fullstack development, preferably in cloud-based SaaS environments.
* Strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks.
* Experience building REST APIs and working with distributed or API-first systems.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* A good understanding of system design, security and modern application architecture.
* Experience with, or an interest in, AI tools and modern development workflows.
* Professional proficiency in English and the right to work in Sweden.


It’s a plus if you have experience from FinTech, RegTech or other regulated industries, or with third-party integrations, or if you speak Swedish.


As a person, you’re curious, self-driven and comfortable taking responsibility for what you build. You enjoy technical discussions, sharing knowledge and finding practical solutions that balance quality, performance and business needs.

##### **What we offer**


With us, you’ll work on technology that helps businesses prevent financial crime and meet increasingly complex regulatory requirements. You’ll join an experienced engineering team with significant influence over architecture, technical decisions and development practices, and you’ll help shape how we use AI and modern technologies across Verified.

* Significant influence over technical decisions and product development.
* An experienced team with a high degree of autonomy and shared ownership.
* Modern cloud technology and AI-driven development.
* 30 days of vacation, plus five “Verified days” for bridge days and holiday flexibility.
* Wellness allowance and occupational pension.
* A hybrid model and prefer working together from our Solna office 2-3 days per week.
* Office breakfasts and snacks, social activities and one moving day per year.

##### **Other information**

* Start: According to agreement
* Extent: Full time
* Location: Our Stockholm office in Solna

##### **The recruitment process**


We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply!


We’re running this recruitment together with our partner Detechtiv. If you have any questions about the role or the process, contact Jonathan at Jonathan@detechtiv.se.


Our selection process is continuous, and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the screening or interview phase.

title: Senior Affärskonsult – Digital handel
description:
Vill du arbeta som konsult och samtidigt bygga affären du arbetar i? Som senior affärskonsult hos Stelltec arbetar du i uppdrag hos våra kunder inom digital handel, och det är där affären växer. Du levererar i projekten, ser nya möjligheter hos kunderna och är med och bygger vårt affärsområde, från första kundmötet till färdig lansering.

**Om rollen**
-------------


Stelltec växer, och digital handel är ett av våra snabbast växande områden. Sedan 2025 har vi byggt upp en specialisering inom digital handel. Nu tar vi nästa steg och söker en senior affärskonsult som förenar affärsförståelse med teknisk höjd och vill bygga affären vidare tillsammans med oss.


Du arbetar där affären möter tekniken: re-platforming, plattformsval, integrationer mot ERP, PIM och OMS och lanseringar på nya marknader.


Du kliver in redan innan projektet finns. Du är med i första dialogen med kunden, i behovsanalysen, när lösningen ritas upp och när affären räknas hem. Sedan stannar du kvar och håller ihop leveransen hela vägen till lansering. Det är så förtroende byggs, och så uppstår nästa affär.


Våra kunder finns i Stockholmsregionen och vi reser normalt inte i uppdragen.

**Det här levererar du hos våra kunder**
----------------------------------------

* Kartlägga kundens processer och förmågor, från sortiment, pris och kampanj till order, betalning, leverans, returer och kundservice, och koppla dem till system, dataflöden och tydligt ägarskap.
* Översätta kommersiella mål till kravbild, målbild och prioriterad roadmap, och hålla ihop dem när verkligheten förändras.
* Ta fram lösningsdesign tillsammans med arkitekter och leverantörer, med rätt integrationsmönster och icke-funktionella krav som håller för volym, kampanjtoppar och framtida utveckling.
* Driva leverantörsutvärderingar och upphandlingar (RFI/RFP), utforma leveransbeskrivningar och följa upp leveranskvalitet.
* Hjälpa kunden att se var AI gör störst nytta i den digitala handeln, till exempel för att hitta brister i produktdata eller fånga upp leveransavvikelser.
* Vara den oberoende parten mellan kund, byrå, plattformsleverantör och systemintegratör, och den som får alla att dra åt samma håll.

**Det här bygger du tillsammans med oss**
-----------------------------------------

* **Affärsutveckling.** Fånga kundens behov, ta fram upplägg och förslag och vara med när vi vinner nya uppdrag.
* **Kundrelationer.** Bygga långsiktiga relationer med kunderna du arbetar hos och se de behov som kan bli nästa uppdrag.
* **Erbjudandet.** Forma leveransmodeller, metodstöd, referenscase och de tjänster vi ska sälja de kommande åren, bland annat arbetssätt där AI frigör tid för rådgivning, som när vi jämför leverantörsförslag.
* **Teamet.** Rekrytera, coacha och bygga upp den kompetens som gör att vi kan ta ett större ansvar hos våra kunder.
* **Nätverket.** Bygga vidare på dina kontakter inom svensk handel och e-handel.

**Det du har med dig**
----------------------

* Flera års erfarenhet av att driva större digitala handelsinitiativ, från konsultsidan eller från en ledande roll på kundsidan där du ägt leveransen.
* Gedigen kunskap om hur digital handel fungerar i praktiken, från produktinformation och prissättning till betalning, order och returer, och om det tekniska ekosystemet runt handeln: e-handelsplattform, CMS, PIM, ERP, OMS, PSP och integrationerna mellan dem.
* Erfarenhet av kravarbete och lösningsdesign i gränslandet mellan affär och teknik. Du kan hålla i pennan själv, inte bara facilitera.
* Förståelse för hur en handelsaffär drivs och skalas och hur kanalerna samverkar, och vana att ta fram business case som visar vad en satsning ger i intäkter och kostnader.
* Erfarenhet av att använda AI i ditt eget arbete, till exempel för att analysera intervjuer eller ta fram kravunderlag. Du kan berätta vad det förbättrade och hur du kontrollerade resultatet.
* Stark kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska, och trygghet i rummet när ledningsgrupp eller styrelse sitter på andra sidan bordet.


Du behöver ingen bakgrund som säljare, men du tycker om att skapa nya uppdrag och utveckla kundrelationer.

**Det är meriterande om du har**
--------------------------------

* Erfarenhet av pre-sales och affärsutveckling i konsultmiljö.
* Bakgrund som e-handelschef, head of digital, digital commerce manager eller produktägare hos ett handels- eller varumärkesbolag.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av någon av de större plattformarna på den svenska marknaden, exempelvis commercetools, Shopify Enterprise, SAP Commerce Cloud/CX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Optimizely eller Litium.
* Erfarenhet av närliggande system som headless CMS, PIM eller OMS.

**Vi kan erbjuda dig**
----------------------

* **Balans i vardagen.** De flesta av oss har familj och behöver få ihop livet med jobbet. Långa kvällar är inte normen hos oss, och vi är tillräckligt seniora för att styra vår egen tid.
* **En nyckelroll i ett växande affärsområde.** Du har verkligt mandat att påverka riktningen och får se resultatet av det du bygger.
* **Uppdrag hos etablerade bolag.** Vi har levererat till bland andra Ericsson, ICA, Apotek Hjärtat, Peak Performance, Fenix Outdoor, Postnord, Coop och Länsförsäkringar. Många uppdrag annonseras aldrig, utan kunderna vänder sig direkt till oss.
* **Kort beslutsväg** och stor entreprenörsanda, utan ett strikt hierarkiskt ramverk i vägen.
* **Attraktiv kompensation** med en fast och en rörlig del, extra ersättning när det krävs några extra timmar i samband med en lansering, samt pensionssparande, löneväxling och friskvård.
* **Utbildningar genom Newground Alliance** inom allt från AI, tech och finans till ledarskap, och utrymme för externa utbildningar när det behövs.

**På Stelltec får du …**
------------------------


… vara med och forma ett bolag i tillväxt. Du handplockas till uppdrag hos svenska och internationella företag där din kunskap och genomförandekraft är avgörande.


Vi är ett kunskapsbolag där våra konsulter är det viktigaste vi har. Vi tror på en kultur där det är nära till en hjälpande hand. Ofta är man Stelltecs enda representant hos kunden, men man är aldrig ensam. Tillsammans har vi trillat ner i de flesta fallgropar som finns, så det finns alltid någon att fråga.


Grunden i vårt erbjudande är ledning och leverans av IT- och techprojekt. Nu bygger vi vidare med digital handel och affärssystem, och du blir en av dem som driver den resan framåt.


Läs mer på www.stelltec.se.

**Vi ingår i Newground Alliance**
---------------------------------


Newground Alliance är en allians av oberoende nischkonsultbolag som tillsammans skapar värdefulla synergieffekter. Totalt finns över 280 erfarna konsulter i alliansen. Alla bolag är ”sina egna” och drivs självständigt, men som konsult kan du samverka med konsulter från övriga bolag, ta hjälp av experter och utbyta kunskap. Alla bolagen delar lokaler på Norrmalmstorg, vilket skapar spontana och värdefulla möten i vardagen.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced Azure engineer who enjoys combining cloud infrastructure, automation and hands-on operations? Do you want to take real ownership of a cloud platform and help build reliable solutions that create value for both colleagues and customers?


We are looking for a Senior Azure Cloud Operations & DevOps Engineer to strengthen our technical capability within Azure, DevOps and cloud operations.

### **The role**


As a Senior Azure Cloud Operations & DevOps Engineer at Optilon, you will play a key role in building, improving and operating the Azure environments that support our applications and services.


This is a broad, hands-on role where you will move between infrastructure, automation, deployment, troubleshooting and technical design. You will work closely with developers, architects, consultants and delivery teams, helping turn architectural decisions into secure, scalable and supportable solutions.


You will take technical and operational ownership throughout the lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and production operations. The role combines Azure infrastructure, cloud operations and DevOps, with a clear focus on reliability, automation and continuous improvement.

### **What you will do**


In this role, you will:

* Build, configure and continuously improve Azure environments for development, test and production.
* Operate production environments and establish effective routines for monitoring, logging, backup, patching, access control and incident management.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and controlled release processes using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar tools.
* Automate operational activities using PowerShell, Bash or other scripting languages.
* Work with Azure Virtual Machines, PaaS services, storage, identity and networking.
* Administer and troubleshoot both Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Build and operate containerized solutions using Docker and Kubernetes, preferably Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Configure and troubleshoot Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, network security groups, routing, private endpoints, DNS and load balancing.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and ensure that proposed solutions are secure, deployable, observable, cost-conscious and supportable.
* Create and maintain platform standards, deployment documentation, operational runbooks and recovery procedures.
* Support development and delivery teams in improving deployment practices and production readiness.


The role has explicit ownership of the operational Azure foundation and deployment capability, while application development remains with the software teams.


### **Who are you?**


We believe that you are a senior and self-driven engineer who enjoys taking responsibility and turning complex technical challenges into practical, maintainable solutions.


You approach operations as an engineering discipline and prefer automation, standardization and repeatable processes over manual work. You are comfortable moving between technical details and broader architectural discussions, while remaining hands-on in implementation and troubleshooting.


You are also:

* Pragmatic and structured in the way you work.
* Comfortable taking responsibility for business-critical production environments.
* Able to analyze issues across applications, operating systems, containers, networks and Azure services.
* Confident in challenging technical designs constructively when they may be difficult to operate, secure or support.
* Service-minded and focused on stability, continuity and measurable outcomes.
* A clear communicator who collaborates effectively with developers, architects, consultants and business stakeholders.
* Comfortable documenting your work and sharing knowledge with others.


The role requires someone who can balance reliability, security, speed, cost and maintainability rather than focusing on only one technical dimension.


### **We believe you have**

* Several years of hands-on experience building and operating production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure infrastructure, networking and relevant PaaS services.
* Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Advanced PowerShell skills and experience with Bash or another scripting language.
* Experience using Git and established version-control workflows.
* Solid administration and troubleshooting skills in both Windows Server and Linux.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling.
* A good understanding of identity, role-based access control, secrets, certificates and cloud security.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, backup, recovery, patching and incident management.
* The ability to contribute to technical architecture while remaining hands-on in implementation and operations.

### **It is an advantage if you also have experience with**

* Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Azure SQL, Application Gateway, Azure Load Balancer and Azure Container Registry.
* Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities and role-based access control.
* Helm, GitOps, Kubernetes ingress, policies and secrets management.
* Hybrid or customer-hosted environments and secure connectivity to Azure.
* High-availability and disaster-recovery solutions.
* Azure governance, cost management, security hardening or compliance controls.

### **Why Optilon?**


At Optilon, you will become part of a knowledge-driven organization where collaboration, responsibility and continuous development are central to how we work.


You will have the opportunity to influence how our Azure platform and operational practices evolve. Your work will have a direct impact on deployment speed, platform stability, security and our ability to deliver reliable solutions.


The role gives you room to combine deep technical work with broader responsibility. You will collaborate with experienced colleagues across application development, architecture, consulting and delivery, while helping establish scalable ways of working for the future.

### **Interested?**


If you have deep Azure experience, a strong operational mindset and enjoy working across infrastructure, automation and application deployment, we would like to hear from you.


Apply today and become part of Optilon!

title: Technical Architect - Infor M3 CloudSuite
description:
Do you want to join a key position at the beginning of a major transformation, where we are building a strong ERP team and modern application landscape from the ground up?


Do you want to be the technical visionary and driving force behind our ERP platform, integrations, and development roadmap in an international environment?


Do you enjoy combining architecture, development, and innovation to create scalable, secure, and future-proof solutions?


If so, this is a unique opportunity to leave your mark on Scandi Standard’s digital transformation journey.


As our **Technical Architect, Infor M3 CloudSuite**, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical landscape of our Infor M3 CloudSuite ecosystem. You will establish the architecture, development standards, integration principles, and technical governance needed to build modern and sustainable solutions supporting our operations and continued growth across the Nordic region and Ireland.

### **The role**


Digitalization is a strategic priority for Scandi Standard, and we are strengthening our Group IT capabilities to support the next phase of our transformation.


We are now looking for a Technical Architect with strong development and integration expertise to join our ERP Application Management team.


Your focus will be on **technical architecture, development standards, integrations, extensibility, and platform governance** across our Infor M3 CloudSuite environment.


Working closely with business stakeholders, solution managers, external partners, and development teams, you will ensure that our ERP landscape remains scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with evolving business needs.


This is an opportunity to join us at an early stage and have significant influence over both our future technical direction and the architecture principles that will guide our enterprise applications.

### **Key responsibilities**


In this role, you will:

* Own the technical architecture of the **Infor M3 CloudSuite** platform and its surrounding application landscape.
* Define and maintain technical standards, development frameworks, architecture principles, and best practices across the ERP ecosystem.
* Lead the design and implementation of integrations between Infor M3 and connected platforms across **Planning, Manufacturing, MES, WMS, HR, BI, Master Data, and Finance**.
* Drive technical solution design for new projects, enhancements, integrations, and business initiatives.
* Act as the technical authority for **Infor M3 development, extensions, APIs, and customization strategies**.
* Work with ERP Solution Managers, GPLs, GPOs, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust and sustainable technical solutions.
* Design and govern integration architecture using **Infor OS, ION, MEC, API Gateway, Event Hub, and cloud services**.
* Establish development standards and **CI/CD, release management, source control, testing, and code quality practices**.
* Lead technical and code reviews and provide guidance to internal developers and implementation partners.
* Mentor and support internal developers and technical consultants.
* Lead technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex system and integration issues.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for **security, compliance, performance, scalability, and maintainability**.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, integration documentation, solution specifications, and development standards.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovations that improve operational efficiency, technical resilience, and business capabilities.

### **Qualifications**


We believe you have:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* **10+ years of experience** in ERP technical architecture, software development, enterprise integration, or similar areas.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Infor M3 CloudSuite and Infor OS**.
* Proven experience in software development and technical solution design in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of relevant Infor technologies, including:


	+ M3 H5 Scripting
	+ M3 Extensions
	+ Infor OS
	+ ION
	+ MEC
	+ API Gateway
	+ Event Hub
	+ Mongoose is considered an advantage.
* Experience designing **cloud-based integration architectures, APIs, and microservice-based solutions**.
* Strong understanding of **Application Lifecycle Management, DevOps, CI/CD, and release governance**.
* Experience with security, authentication, and authorization standards such as **OAuth 2.0, SAML, and Single Sign-On**.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, master data management, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience leading or providing technical direction to developers, consultants, and external vendors.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Excellent English skills and working proficiency in **Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish**.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

### **Preferred experience**


It is an advantage if you also have:

* Experience with **Infor M3 in Food & Beverage** or another complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience from major **ERP transformations or cloud migrations**.
* Experience working in multinational manufacturing organizations.
* Knowledge of **Microsoft Azure integration services and cloud-native architecture**.
* Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization across complex ERP and integration landscapes.

title: Member of Technical Staff - SRE
description:
### **About the role**


Sferical AI was founded by AstraZeneca, Ericsson, Saab, SEB and Wallenberg Investments to give Swedish industry secure, sovereign computing capacity for AI. Our first supercomputer, Sferical One, is built on NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD architecture. We’re looking for an experienced AI platform engineer to build the platform our partners use to develop, serve and deploy AI.


You’ll join a team whose mission is to drive Sferical AI’s success through workload leadership, helping our customers reach their goals for sovereignty and competitiveness with AI. You’ll also help build Sferical AI into a company that embodies the opportunity AI presents, running on a modern technology platform that integrates our own AI capability, both in our technical mission and in our thought leadership within the Wallenberg sphere.


As a member of technical staff, you are:

* A recognized peer in a highly skilled group with collective responsibility for our platform.
* Expected to contribute across the platform design cycle, from strategy and architecture to design, validation and support, and across every part of the platform where you have experience, from hardware and installation to compute, storage, orchestration and security.
* Expected to take particular ownership of the areas where your expertise is strongest, which for this role means AI platform engineering.
* Invested in our customers’ success, contributing to integration and troubleshooting, and occasionally acting as lead or single point of contact toward a customer or partner.
* Encouraged to contribute in all areas together with your peers, without being expected to act autonomously in all of them.
* Free to step outside narrow role descriptions such as developer, data scientist or architect, and to grow your skills in line with our customer commitments and the team’s day-to-day work.
* Responsible for producing work your peers can build on, with clear design, architectural consistency, good documentation and solid workmanship.
* Expected to lead by example, speak up and help keep the team psychologically safe.

### **What you'll own as our SRE**

* Core operational processes, including incident management, change and release management, and clear escalation paths.
* The SLAs, SLOs and KPIs that matter (uptime, job success rates, GPU utilization, mean time to recovery), tracked and reported openly to leadership and partners.
* Hardware lifecycle and failure handling, including spares, RMA processes, firmware and driver updates, and maintenance windows planned to minimize disruption.

### **What you bring**

* Experience in SRE or infrastructure operations in large-scale or mission-critical environments such as HPC, GPU clusters, cloud platforms or data centers.
* Strong hands-on technical skills, for example with cluster schedulers (Slurm, Kubernetes or similar), hardware failure patterns and maintenance planning.
* Experience designing and implementing ITSM processes (ITIL or similar), adapting them to a young, fast-moving organization rather than applying them by the book.
* A data-driven approach: you’re comfortable defining metrics, building dashboards and using numbers to drive improvement.
* Experience with compliance and audits in regulated or security-sensitive environments is a plus.
* Fluency in English; Swedish is a strong plus. Swedish citizenship is mandatory.


This role is based at our Stockholm office, five days a week. We build best together, and we believe working side by side drives better results.

title: Data Center Engineering Technician
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.  

  

Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.  

o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.  

o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.  

o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.  

o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.  

o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.  

  

A day in the life  

o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center.  

o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained.  

o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works.  

o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties.  

o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover.  

o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development.  

o Event response and drill participation.
  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------


- - 1 to 4 years of electrical, mechanical and/or controls relevant experience (degree or trade qualification preferred) with demonstrated key electrical and mechanical competencies and theory.  

- - Ability to follow procedures system documentation and track issues through appropriate entries into a Trouble Ticket system and apply safe electrical practice according to guidelines set by relevant electrical safety supervisory bodies, while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs) through the implementation of proactive issue detection and immediate response.  

- - Competent in use of basic IT programs such as MS Word/Excel or similar; Valid driving license and able to cover a 24x7 shift rotation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------


- - Heavy industry or data center experience.  

- - Working knowledge of generic mechanical-room infrastructure such as chillers, Air Handling Units, and fan controls.  

- - Working knowledge of backup generator systems.  

- - Maintenance or construction experience  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Lead AI Architect
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
  

  

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.  

  

  



**Role Summary**
----------------


The AI Architect shapes the architecture that enables enterprise-grade AI and agentic solutions to be built, deployed, governed, monitored, and scaled across Scania.  

  

  



The role designs the technical foundation for AI agents, model integration, orchestration, knowledge retrieval, memory, tool integration, model routing, security, identity, governance, observability, evaluation, and self-service capabilities.  

  

  



The AI Architect also guides Scania's model strategy, including when to use commercial, open-source, self-hosted, fine-tuned, or internally developed models. The role combines strong architecture expertise with deep knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, cost-effective, and aligned with Scania's long-term technology strategy.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**AI and Platform Architecture**
  

Define and evolve the end-to-end architecture for AI and agentic platforms, including agent execution, workflow orchestration, APIs, identity, governance, memory, knowledge services, observability, and evaluation.


**Model Strategy and Architecture**
  

Define architectural approaches for commercial, open-source, self-hosted, fine-tuned, domain-specific, and internally developed AI models. Evaluate models based on quality, latency, cost, safety, explainability, data control, deployment model, and suitability for Scania use cases.


**AI Model Development and Lifecycle**
  

Guide model development, training, fine-tuning, adaptation, evaluation, optimization, inference, and production deployment. Define standards for experimentation, dataset management, model versioning, governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management.


**Agentic AI Architecture**
  

Design architectural patterns for AI agents, including planning, tool use, memory, multi-agent coordination, human approval, verification, guardrails, and orchestration.


**Knowledge and RAG Architecture**
  

Design enterprise capabilities for retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge services, including ingestion, document processing, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, context building, citations, and grounding verification.


**Model Gateway and Routing**
  

Architect model gateway and routing capabilities, including provider abstraction, fallback strategies, self-hosted model support, model selection, and cost-aware routing.


**Reusable AI Platform Services**
  

Design reusable platform capabilities such as agent execution, workflow engines, model routing, tool registries, skill execution, memory services, context building, policy enforcement, audit logging, and usage and cost tracking.


**Security and Governance**
  

Embed security and governance throughout the AI lifecycle, including identity and access management, RBAC, policy enforcement, human approval gates, auditability, prompt-injection protection, PII handling, sandboxing, budget controls, and threat modeling.


**Technology Evaluation and Standards**
  

Evaluate AI frameworks, orchestration patterns, model providers, tools, connectors, and architectural building blocks. Establish reusable architectural patterns and technical standards that support scalability, interoperability, and vendor independence.


**Stakeholder Management and Technical Leadership**
  

Collaborate with Product Owners, architects, engineering teams, security, data, infrastructure, and other stakeholders to translate business and product priorities into technically feasible solutions. Communicate architectural decisions through diagrams, decision records, patterns, technical guidance, and coaching.


**Personal Capability Building**
  

Maintain deep knowledge of developments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, agentic AI, cloud architecture, AI security, and industry best practices. Contribute to knowledge sharing and capability development across Scania.

  

**Who You Are**
---------------


**Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning**
  

Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning, including neural networks, transformers, embeddings, attention mechanisms, language models, multimodal models, classification, ranking, and generative AI.


**Model Development and Optimization**
  

Hands-on understanding of model development, training, fine-tuning, evaluation, optimization, deployment, model serving, inference optimization, distillation, and quantization.


**Agentic AI and RAG**
  

Strong understanding of agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, orchestration patterns, memory, evaluation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and AI safety.


**MLOps and LLMOps**
  

Strong knowledge of experiment tracking, dataset management, model registries, evaluation pipelines, model monitoring, drift detection, lifecycle management, and production deployment.


**Cloud and Platform Architecture**
  

Experience designing AI, data, cloud, integration, or enterprise platforms, including cloud-native architecture, containerized workloads, GPU-based environments, secure runtimes, CI/CD, monitoring, tracing, and scalable infrastructure.


**Enterprise Identity and Security**
  

Good understanding of enterprise identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, service accounts, and permission propagation.


**Communication and Technical Leadership**
  

Ability to communicate complex AI and architecture topics clearly and translate strategic requirements into reusable architectural patterns and practical technical guidance.


**This Is Us**
--------------


AI is evolving at tremendous speed. But AI itself does not create value. Value comes when we use it to change how we work, make better decisions and create better products and services for our customers.We are the AI Enablement section within Scania’s IT organisation, working to make AI a natural and scalable part of how Scania works. We combine AI expertise, technology, product ownership and enablement to help colleagues adopt AI and turn its possibilities into real value.
  

  

We work across Scania, together with business teams, technology teams and external partners. Our work spans AI platforms and tools, adoption, governance, capability building and new ways of working. We help people and teams understand where AI can make a difference, build confidence in using it and translate new capabilities into everyday work.
  

  

We are a diverse team with different backgrounds, expertise and perspectives, united by curiosity and a shared ambition to shape how AI is adopted and used at Scania.

  

  

We actively support you in:


* Growing your expertise in AI, emerging technologies and AI adoption
* Working with rapidly evolving technology in a practical enterprise environment
* Collaborating across business, technology and organisational boundaries
* Experimenting, learning and turning new AI capabilities into scalable solutions and new ways of working

title: Product Engineer – AI & Business Innovation
description:
**Product Engineer – AI & Business Innovation**
===============================================

### **Build products. Challenge conventions. Rethink what's possible.**


Tänk om din nästa roll som utvecklare inte bara handlade om att bygga en bättre produkt, utan också om att utveckla ett helt företag?


AI förändrar fundamentalt hur vi bygger produkter, löser problem och driver verksamheter. Gamla sanningar utmanas, nya möjligheter uppstår och avståndet mellan idé och verklighet blir allt kortare.


För vår kunds räkning söker vi en nyfiken, driven och produktorienterad utvecklare som vill befinna sig mitt i den förändringen. En person som kombinerar teknisk kompetens med ett entreprenöriellt mindset och en genuin vilja att skapa värde.

**Om bolaget**
--------------


Vår kund är ett innovativt produktbolag i skärningspunkten mellan teknologi, digitalt lärande och verksamhetsutveckling. Bolaget befinner sig på en spännande och snabb tillväxtresa med stora ambitioner för såväl produkten som verksamheten.


Du kommer att ha en nyckelroll i bolagets tekniska utveckling, med stora möjligheter att påverka produktens framtid, tekniska vägval och hur organisationen arbetar.


Här finns utrymme att experimentera, utmana, tänka nytt och framför allt göra verklighet av idéer.

**Mer än en traditionell utvecklarroll**
----------------------------------------


Vi söker inte en utvecklare som enbart vill plocka upp ärenden från en backlog och leverera nya features. Vi söker någon som vill förstå helheten, identifiera möjligheter och aktivt bidra till bolagets utveckling.


Du kommer att röra dig naturligt mellan produktutveckling, teknik, AI, affär och verksamhetsutveckling.


I rollen kommer du att:

* Vidareutveckla produkten med fokus på användarupplevelse och kundvärde.
* Utforska och implementera AI-drivna funktioner och nya produktmöjligheter.
* Använda AI som en integrerad del av utvecklingsarbetet.
* Förbättra interna processer och arbetssätt genom AI, automation och teknologi.
* Snabbt omsätta idéer och hypoteser till fungerande lösningar.
* Bidra till tekniska vägval och bolagets långsiktiga utveckling.
* Arbeta nära verksamheten för att identifiera nya möjligheter och skapa affärsvärde.

**Vem är du?**
--------------


Vi tror att du har omkring 4–5 års erfarenhet eller mer av mjukvaru- och produktutveckling. Men det är inte antalet år i ditt CV som är avgörande. Det är hur du tänker, hur du arbetar och vad du har för ambitioner.


Vi tror att du:

* Har erfarenhet av modern fullstack- och produktutveckling.
* Är en AI-peer – du ser AI som en naturlig samarbetspartner i din problemlösning och utvecklingsprocess.
* Är genuint nyfiken på AI, LLM:er, agenter, automation och framväxande teknologier.
* Har ett produktorienterat och entreprenöriellt mindset.
* Är pragmatisk och lösningsorienterad snarare än dogmatisk kring teknik, metoder och ramverk.
* Har ett starkt eget driv, tar initiativ och vågar utmana det etablerade.
* Är prestigelös och bidrar där du kan skapa störst värde.
* Kan balansera högt utvecklingstempo med teknisk kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.


Du behöver inte vara expert på allt. Däremot behöver du ha en stark vilja och förmåga att kontinuerligt lära dig nya saker.

**AI är inte bara ett verktyg. Det är ett nytt sätt att tänka.**
----------------------------------------------------------------


För oss handlar AI om betydligt mer än att generera kod snabbare. Det handlar om att ompröva hur vi löser problem, utvecklar produkter och bygger verksamheter.


Vi söker dig som naturligt ställer frågor som:

* Hur skulle vi lösa det här problemet om vi började från noll idag?
* Vad kan vi åstadkomma nu som tidigare inte varit möjligt?
* Hur kan vi skapa mer kundvärde med mindre komplexitet?
* Hur kan AI förstärka hela organisationens förmåga, inte bara utvecklingsteamets?

**Kultur och arbetsplats**
--------------------------


Bolaget arbetar utifrån ett **office-first-mindset**, där nära samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och kreativitet är viktiga delar av kulturen. Merparten av arbetstiden förväntas därför vara på plats på kontoret i centrala Stockholm.

**Känner du igen dig?**
-----------------------


Du älskar att bygga saker. Du är nyfiken på framtiden. Du experimenterar, lär dig och drivs av att göra saker bättre.


Du ser inte din yrkesroll som begränsad till att skriva kod, utan som en möjlighet att skapa förändring genom teknologi.


Här får du möjlighet att påverka på riktigt, ta en nyckelroll och växa tillsammans med ett ambitiöst produktbolag i snabb utveckling.


Då vill vi gärna träffa dig.

**Don't just build software. Build what's next.**

title: Vikarierande lönespecialist till Stockholm
description:
**Vikarierande lönespecialist till Stockholm**
==============================================


Vill du vara ett stöd till Sweco Sveriges medarbetare och chefer? Gillar du att jobba med service och komma med förslag på förbättringar? För ett föräldravikariat på ett år söker vi nu en lönespecialist med erfarenhet av att arbeta med hela löneprocessen. Är det du eller någon du känner? Läs mer och ansök nedan.


**Varför jobba hos oss?**


I vårt löneteam arbetar du tillsammans med 9 kollegor som har lång och bred erfarenhet inom lön och HR. Vi har roligt tillsammans och jobbar med att ständigt förbättra våra processer samt dela kunskap och erfarenheter. Vi samarbetar dagligen med våra kollegor inom HR och Finans. När en av våra kollegor i teamet nu ska gå på föräldraledighet söker vi dig som vill arbeta brett och bidra till teamet och Sweco.


Hos Sweco blir du en del av en gemenskap. I våra relationer till varandra och till våra kunder hittar vi styrkan, nyfikenheten och lösningarna att komma framåt – både i jobbet och i livet. Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats för att du ska kunna styra dina dagar i största möjliga mån, genom ansvar, frihet och stöttande kollegor.


**Din framtida roll**


Löneteamet ger dagligen service till ca 8 000 medarbetare och chefer runt om i Sverige. Som lönespecialist härkommer du exempelvis att:


* Arbeta med löpande lönehantering i HRM Software
* Supportera verksamheten via ärendehantering i ServiceNow samt över telefon
* Bidra till utveckling av system och tjänster
* Tillsammans med en kollega ansvara för ett specialistområde inom lön och hålla dig uppdaterad, samt driva utveckling inom det området
* Samarbeta i olika forum med HR/Finans/IT

Detta är ett vikariat på heltid under ett års tid med möjlighet till förlängning och tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Din placering kommer vara på vårt huvudkontor i Marieberg, Stockholm.


*”Som ledare är jag lyhörd, driven och engagerad. Jag inspireras av människor som drivs av att allt är möjligt och som gillar att tänka utanför boxen. Jag tror på teamwork och att alla tar ansvar och bidrar med sin unika kompetens. I min roll som ledare är det viktigt att alltid finnas där som stöd. ”*


*Sara Hydling, Gruppchef Lön*


**Den vi söker – är det du?**


Krav för rollen:


* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom lön alternativt likvärdig erfarenhet.
* Minst 2 års relevant erfarenhet av arbete med lön och lönefrågor.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med alla delar i löneprocessen såsom lönebearbetning och rapportering till myndigheter och finans.
* God förmåga att kommunicera i tal och skrift på svenska.

Det är meriterande, men inte ett krav, om du har erfarenhet av HRM Software och ServiceNow samt om du arbetat inom området i en större verksamhet.


Som person är du servicemedveten, har god kommunikativ förmåga och en vilja att förstå våra interna kunders utmaningar. Du är nyfiken och tycker om att testa nya lösningar för att utveckla och effektivisera processer. Du tar hjälp och söker lösningar för att komma framåt, vill själv utvecklas och vill även vara med och utveckla dina kollegor. Vi värdesätter samarbete och tror att du, liksom vi, ser fördelarna med att dela med dig av kunskap, idéer och feedback.


**Ansökan**


Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Vi hänvisar samtliga ansökningar till ansökningsformuläret nedan.


Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


**Kontakta oss**


Vill du höra mer om tjänsten och hur vi jobbar i gruppen? Välkommen att kontakta Gruppchef Sara Hydling på sara.hydling@sweco.se.


Vill du vara med och forma framtiden?
  

Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

  

På Sweco vill vi vara en arbetsplats präglad av mångfald. Vi tror att fler perspektiv breddar vår förmåga att fortsätta nå våra mål och eftersträvar mångfald i våra rekryteringsprocesser.
  

Sweco planerar och utformar morgondagens hållbara samhällen och städer. Med den samlade kunskapen hos våra 23 000 arkitekter, ingenjörer och andra experter arbetar vi tillsammans med våra kunder för att möjliggöra den gröna omställningen, maximera digitaliseringens potential och stärka Europas konkurrenskraft och resiliens. Sweco är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom arkitektur och teknik med en omsättning på cirka 32 miljarder SEK under 2025. Företaget är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Systemingenjör (System Engineer) till Sigma Industry Innovation i Örebro
description:
### **Job description**


**Systemingenjör**


Som systemingenjör arbetar du med utveckling, integration och vidareutveckling av avancerade kommunikations-, självskydds- och spaningssystem hos vår försvarskund. Rollen omfattar kravhantering, systemdesign, arkitekturarbete samt integration mot plattform och tekniska system. Jobbet innebär att man följer systemen genom hela livscykeln, från koncept och utveckling till verifiering, driftsättning och support.


Arbetet sker i nära samarbete projektledare, utvecklare och tekniska specialister. Du bidrar med tekniskt stöd, säkerställer fungerande helhetslösningar och hjälper till att hantera komplexa system och gränssnitt.


Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av systemarbete inom högteknologisk industri.


* Civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom exempelvis teknisk fysik, elektronik, datateknik
* Flerårig erfarenhet av systemarbete, kravhantering och systemdesign
* Kunskap inom nätverk, kommunikationssystem och systemintegration
* God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att se helheten
* Erfarenhet av kravhanterings verktyg så som DOORS

Meriterande kunskaper och erfarenheter:


* Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin
* RF, radar eller annan signalbehandlingsteknik
* IT- och nätverkssäkerhet
* Komplexa datornätverk, nätverksadministration och övervakning
* Linux, skriptning eller förmåga att läsa och förstå kod
* Utbildning och handledning av andra
* Processer för säkerhetskritiska system inom flyg (RTCA), fordonsindustrin eller medicinteknik
* Kompetens inom EMC, kraftförsörjning, kyla, ventilation och klimatsystem (AC)

### **We offer**


Sigma Industry är ett teknikkonsultbolag med fokus på industriell utveckling. Uppdragen genomförs i teknikintensiva miljöer inom exempelvis fordons-, tillverknings- och försvarsindustrin.


Konsulten är som en astronaut på uppdrag i olika terräng och miljöer. Precis som astronauter utforskar världar, navigerar konsulter nya projekt och miljöer. Båda behöver anpassa sig snabbt till aktuella förutsättningar. Konsulten bidra med fräscha perspektiv och lösningar, tack vare erfarenheten från olika uppdragsgivare. När uppdraget är klart återvänder de till basen, redo för nästa resa.


Sigma är ett entreprenörsdrivet bolag där beslutsvägarna är korta och där vi lägger stor vikt vid långsiktiga relationer, både med våra kunder och våra konsulter.

Logistics, Electricity & Automation, Energy & Power Engineering, Hardware Electronics, Testing and Verification, Project Management & Management, Audio/Acoustics, Project Management, Software development embedded systems, RF And Microwave, Function development, System design, System development, Operation, support and infrastructure, Test & Quality, Business Analysis, Digital Communication, Requirement Management & Business Development, Project Management, Software development, Digitalisation, Digitalisation, Automation
